name: Smith Jane
summary_feedback: Your writing clearly tells a short story, but there are many grammar and spelling mistakes that make it informal and incorrect for academic work. Focus on correct verb tenses, standard spelling, and proper capitalization of 'I' and sentence beginnings. Try breaking long run-on sentences into shorter, properly punctuated ones.

issues.comment: Incorrect negative and verb tense combination.
Incorrect past tense form of the verb 'say'.
Incorrect verb tense; should be past tense.
Incorrect past tense form of the verb 'fall'.
Informal contraction inappropriate for formal writing.

issues.quote: yesturday i was going to the shop but then the rain was like super heavy so i dont wanted to walk anymore
issues.correction: Yesterday I was going to the shop, but then the rain was very heavy, so I didn't want to walk anymore

issues.quote: but my friend sayed its fine and we go anyways.
issues.comment: Missing apostrophe in 'it's' and incorrect tense sequence.
issues.correction: but my friend said it's fine and we went anyway.

issues.comment: Sentence should begin with a capital letter.
